patterns: APPSC asks direct attributions: Panchatantra = Vishnu Sharma, Aryabhata first to treat maths as a distinct subject, Romaka Siddhanta = astronomy, Ajanta = Buddhist, Cave 10 Chhaddanta Jataka.
Author-work pairs dominate PSC PYQs (Kalidasa's works, 'not by Kalidasa' with Shringara Shataka/Mudrarakshasa traps, Bhasa, Dandin, Bharavi, Vishakhadatta).
Scientist -> contribution: Aryabhata earth rotation/place value, Brahmagupta gravitation/zero, Varahamihira encyclopaedic Brihat Samhita, Lilavati = Bhaskara II (not Gupta).
Art items: Ajanta (Waghora, Vakatakas, Padmapani), Bagh Hallisaka, Bhitargaon brick temple, Gupta silver coin = Rupaka.
App has many multi-statement items with fine details (temple stages, cave numbers, coin types) - deeper than APPSC's single-fact style but mostly sound.
